title: Megh Youth Visit Gandhi Ashram, Ahmedabad
excerpt: Around 50 youth volunteers visited Gandhi Ashram to engage with values of Swadeshi, simple living, non-violence, and purpose-driven leadership.
coverImageAlt: Megh Foundation youth leaders during Gandhi Ashram learning visit
bodyMarkdown:
## Purpose of the visit

Megh Foundation youth volunteers visited Gandhi Ashram, Ahmedabad, to connect leadership practice with values rooted in truth, simplicity, and service.

## Key reflections from the learning journey

- **Swadeshi:** building local confidence and self-reliance
- **Simple living:** impact does not require excess
- **Ahimsa and truth:** leadership through discipline and moral courage
- **Community responsibility:** transforming values into action

## Why this matters for youth leadership

The visit helped participants translate historical learning into contemporary leadership principles for community change.

## Way forward

The foundation continues to create such value-based exposure opportunities so young leaders can build both vision and responsibility.
